title: House with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- roof -->
  <polygon points='50,12 92,45 8,45' fill='#ff6b6b' stroke='#ff9f9f' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- roof shading left -->
  <polygon points='50,12 8,45 30,45' fill='#e05555'/>
  <!-- house body -->
  <rect x='18' y='45' width='64' height='45' rx='4' fill='#ffd166' stroke='#ffe599' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='38' y='62' width='24' height='28' rx='3' fill='#8b5e34' stroke='#b07a4a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- door knob -->
  <circle cx='56' cy='78' r='2.5' fill='#ffe599'/>
  <!-- left window -->
  <rect x='24' y='54' width='12' height='12' rx='2' fill='#6ec6ff' stroke='#a8dcff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- right window -->
  <rect x='64' y='54' width='12' height='12' rx='2' fill='#6ec6ff' stroke='#a8dcff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- window crossbars left -->
  <line x1='30' y1='54' x2='30' y2='66' stroke='#a8dcff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='24' y1='60' x2='36' y2='60' stroke='#a8dcff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- window crossbars right -->
  <line x1='70' y1='54' x2='70' y2='66' stroke='#a8dcff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='60' x2='76' y2='60' stroke='#a8dcff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 74 Q50 82 58 74' fill='none' stroke='#4a2c0a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='70' r='3' fill='#ff9f9f'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='70' r='3' fill='#ff9f9f'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='59' r='3' fill='#4a2c0a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='59' r='3' fill='#4a2c0a'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='58' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='58' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- chimney -->
  <rect x='68' y='16' width='10' height='20' rx='1' fill='#c97b4a' stroke='#e89b6a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- chimney smoke -->
  <circle cx='73' cy='10' r='3' fill='#d9d9d9' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='5' r='2' fill='#d9d9d9' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- grass -->
  <rect x='8' y='90' width='84' height='4' rx='2' fill='#6bcf6b'/>
</svg>
